<!doctype html>

<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(216,216,false);
renderer.outputColorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene=new THREE.Scene();
const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-108,108,108,-108,.1,1200);
ref.position.set(0,108,450);
ref.lookAt(0,108,0);

const TAU=Math.PI*2, radians=Math.PI/180;
const smooth=THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep;
const lerp=THREE.MathUtils.lerp;
const color=h=>new THREE.Color(h);
const point=(x,y,z)=>new THREE.Vector3(x-108,216-y,z);
function group(parent,name){
  const g=new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
let seed=92413;
function random(){
  seed=(Math.imul(seed,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;
  return seed/4294967296;
}
const backdrop=document.createElement('canvas');
backdrop.width=backdrop.height=64;
const ctx=backdrop.getContext('2d');
const pixels=ctx.createImageData(64,64);
for(let y=0;y<64;y++)for(let x=0;x<64;x++){
  const u=x/63,v=y/63;
  const shade=smooth(v,.78,1)*(20+18*Math.exp(-((u-.55)**2)/.13));
  const grain=(random()-.5)*2+.9*Math.sin(17*u+9*v);
  const i=(64*y+x)*4;
  pixels.data[i]=249-shade+grain;
  pixels.data[i+1]=250-shade+grain;
  pixels.data[i+2]=247-shade+grain;
  pixels.data[i+3]=255;
}
ctx.putImageData(pixels,0,0);
const bg=new THREE.CanvasTexture(backdrop);
bg.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;

const noise=new Uint8Array(64*64*4);
for(let i=0;i<noise.length;i+=4){
  noise[i]=noise[i+1]=noise[i+2]=241+Math.floor(random()*15);
  noise[i+3]=255;
}
const fleck=new THREE.DataTexture(noise,64,64);
fleck.wrapS=fleck.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;
fleck.magFilter=THREE.LinearFilter;
fleck.minFilter=THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
fleck.generateMipmaps=true;

const skin=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  vertexColors:true,map:fleck,roughness:.96,side:THREE.DoubleSide

const palmMat=velvet(0x53412e),fingerMat=velvet(0x493a2b);
const browMat=velvet(0x382416),lidMat=velvet(0xdcb744);

const creature=group(scene,'laughing-golden-creature');
const honey=color(0xe7b72d),sun=color(0xefcf44),amber=color(0xc68a31),belly=color(0xdeaf83);
function fur(y){
  return sun.clone().lerp(honey,smooth(y,26,119)).lerp(amber,smooth(y,123,222)*.88);
}
function cubic(a,b,c,d,t){
  return b+.5*t*(c-a+t*(2*a-5*b+4*c-d+t*(3*(b-c)+d-a)));
}
function sample(keys,u){
  const s=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,u))*(keys.length-1);
  const i=Math.min(keys.length-2,Math.floor(s));
  return keys[i].map((v,k)=>cubic(keys[Math.max(0,i-1)][k],v,
    keys[i+1][k],keys[Math.min(keys.length-1,i+2)][k],s-i));
}
function gridMesh(parent,name,rows,material,paint,reverse=false){
  const p=[],c=[],uv=[],idx=[],n=rows[0].length;
  rows.forEach((row,j)=>row.forEach((v,i)=>{
    p.push(v.x,v.y,v.z);
    if(paint){
      const tint=paint(j,i,v);
      c.push(tint.r,tint.g,tint.b);
    }
    uv.push(i/n*4,j/(rows.length-1)*3);
    if(j<rows.length-1){
      const a=j*n+i,b=j*n+(i+1)%n,d=a+n,e=b+n;
      if(reverse)idx.push(a,d,b,b,d,e);
      else idx.push(a,b,d,b,e,d);
    }
  }));
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(p,3));
  geo.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));
  if(paint)geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(c,3));
  geo.setIndex(idx);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,material);
  mesh.name=name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}
function section(keys,u){
  const [x,y,z,rx,rz]=sample(keys,u);
  return [x,y,z,Math.max(.015,rx),Math.max(.015,rz)];
}
function loft(parent,name,keys,mat=skin,paint=null,n=64,steps=(keys.length-1)*5){
  const rows=[];
  for(let j=0;j<=steps;j++){
    const [x,y,z,rx,rz]=section(keys,j/steps);
    rows.push(Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>{
      const a=TAU*i/n;
      return point(x+rx*Math.cos(a),y,z+rz*Math.sin(a));
    }));
  }
  return gridMesh(parent,name,rows,mat,mat===skin?
    (j,i,v)=>paint?paint(216-v.y,TAU*i/n,v):fur(216-v.y):null);
}

// Each section follows the shoulder, elbow, waist, or knee through the laugh.
const times=[0,180,340,520,680,860,1020,1200,1220];
const motion=[
  {bend:0,lift:0,shoulder:0,hip:0,dy:0},
  {bend:1,lift:0,shoulder:0,hip:0,dy:0},
  {bend:0,lift:1,shoulder:0,hip:0,dy:0},

  {bend:.08,lift:0,shoulder:-10,hip:-4,dy:3},

function morphSheets(mesh,arrays){
  const geo=mesh.geometry;
  geo.morphAttributes.position=[];
  geo.morphAttributes.normal=[];
  for(const arr of arrays){
    const pos=new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(arr,3);
    const temp=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    temp.setIndex(geo.index);
    temp.setAttribute('position',pos);
    temp.computeVertexNormals();
    geo.morphAttributes.position.push(pos);
    geo.morphAttributes.normal.push(temp.getAttribute('normal'));
  }
  mesh.updateMorphTargets();
  mesh.frustumCulled=false;
  animated.push(mesh);
}
function posedKeys(rest,duck,rise,k,leg=false){
  const m=motion[k];
  return rest.map((ring,i)=>{
    const v=ring.map((a,j)=>a+(duck[i][j]-a)*m.bend+(rise[i][j]-a)*m.lift);
    const weight=leg?0:1-smooth(ring[1],60,184);
    v[0]+=lerp(m.hip,m.shoulder,weight);
    v[1]+=m.dy*(leg?1-smooth(ring[1],190,243):1);
    return v;
  });
}
function movingLoft(g,name,rest,duck,rise,paint=null,n=64,steps=(rest.length-1)*5,leg=false){
  const mesh=loft(g,name,rest,skin,paint,n,steps);
  const poses=[rest],arrays=[];

    const keys=posedKeys(rest,duck,rise,k,leg);
    poses.push(keys);
    const arr=new Float32Array((steps+1)*n*3);
    let index=0;
    for(let j=0;j<=steps;j++){
      const [x,y,z,rx,rz]=section(keys,j/steps);
      for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
        const a=TAU*i/n;
        arr[index++]=x-108+rx*Math.cos(a);
        arr[index++]=216-y;
        arr[index++]=z+rz*Math.sin(a);
      }
    }
    arrays.push(arr);
  }
  morphSheets(mesh,arrays);
  return poses;
}

const legL=[

const rightRest=[

function digit(g,name,keys){
  return loft(g,name,keys.map(([x,y,z,r])=>[x,y,z,r,.94*r]),fingerMat,null,20);
}
const lh=group(leftArm,'left-hand');

function wristPositions(poses,i){

function placeHand(hand,wrists,angles,i,j,u){
  const angle=lerp(angles[i],angles[j],u)*radians;
  hand.rotation.z=angle;
  const pivot=wrists[0].clone().applyQuaternion(hand.quaternion);
  hand.position.copy(wrists[i]).lerp(wrists[j],u).sub(pivot);
}

const head=group(creature,'upturned-head');
const face=group(head,'face'),mouth=group(head,'open-laughing-mouth'),eyes=group(head,'squeezed-eyes');
const ox=116,oy=50;
function outline(points){
  return new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points.map(([x,y])=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,0)),true,'centripetal').getPoints(360);
}
const skull=outline([

  [101.7,32.8],[106.2,32.4],[114.2,33.7],[123.2,36],[132.8,39.2],[137.9,41.6],
  [136.7,45.1],[132.4,52.8],[126.1,61.9],[119.1,68.9],[113.1,71.3],
  [107.5,70.2],[103.4,66.3],[101,60.2],[100.1,51.3],[100.4,40]
]);
function radius(path,dx,dy){
  let nearest=1e4;
  for(let i=1;i<path.length;i++){
    const a=path[i-1],b=path[i],sx=b.x-a.x,sy=b.y-a.y;
    const det=dx*sy-dy*sx;
    if(Math.abs(det)<1e-7)continue;
    const ax=a.x-ox,ay=a.y-oy;
    const r=(ax*sy-ay*sx)/det,t=(ax*dy-ay*dx)/det;
    if(r>0&&t>=0&&t<=1)nearest=Math.min(nearest,r);
  }
  return nearest;
}
function skullDepth(x,y,r,R){
  return 8.5-.13*(x-119)-.065*(y-45)+24.2*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-(r/R)**2));
}
const N=104;
const rays=Array.from({length:N},(_,i)=>{
  const a=TAU*i/N,dx=Math.cos(a),dy=Math.sin(a);
  return {dx,dy,R:radius(skull,dx,dy),m:radius(opening,dx,dy)};
});
const rows=[],tints=[];
const goldenFace=color(0xeaca43),chin=color(0xe2ad4d),lip=color(0xdbac69);
for(let j=0;j<=36;j++){
  const u=j/36,row=[],cols=[];
  for(const {dx,dy,R,m} of rays){
    const r=m+(R-m)*Math.sin(u*Math.PI/2);
    const x=ox+r*dx,y=oy+r*dy,dist=r-m;
    const lipWidth=dy>.05?4.7:2.3;
    const pad=Math.exp(-(dist**2)/(2*lipWidth**2));
    row.push(point(x,y,skullDepth(x,y,r,R)+pad*(dy>.1?3:1.7)));
    cols.push(goldenFace.clone().lerp(chin,smooth(y,45,85)*.75).lerp(lip,pad*(.5+.23*dy)));
  }
  rows.push(row);tints.push(cols);
}
gridMesh(face,'cheeks-muzzle-and-forehead',rows,skin,(j,i)=>tints[j][i]);
const backRows=[];
for(let j=0;j<=32;j++){
  const a=j/32*Math.PI/2;
  backRows.push(rays.map(({dx,dy,R})=>{
    const r=R*Math.cos(a),x=ox+dx*r,y=oy+dy*r;
    return point(x,y,8.5-.13*(x-119)-.065*(y-45)-25.2*Math.sin(a));
  }));
}
gridMesh(head,'back-of-skull',backRows,skin,(j,i,v)=>fur(216-v.y));
const cavity=[],cavityColors=[];
const innerLip=color(0x75452c),throat=color(0x170c09),deep=color(0x0d0807);
for(let j=0;j<=32;j++){
  const u=j/32,row=[],cols=[];
  for(const {dx,dy,R,m} of rays){
    const r=m*(1-u),x=ox+dx*r,y=oy+dy*r;
    const edge=skullDepth(ox+m*dx,oy+m*dy,m,R)+(dy>.1?3:1.7);
    row.push(point(x,y,edge-12*Math.sin(u*Math.PI/2)**.76-2*u));
    cols.push(innerLip.clone().lerp(throat,smooth(m*u,0,2.1)).lerp(deep,smooth(u,.12,.8)));
  }
  cavity.push(row);cavityColors.push(cols);
}
gridMesh(mouth,'recessed-mouth-interior',cavity,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  vertexColors:true,roughness:1,side:THREE.DoubleSide
}),(j,i)=>cavityColors[j][i],true);
function faceZ(x,y){
  const r=Math.hypot(x-ox,y-oy)||.001;
  return skullDepth(x,y,r,radius(skull,(x-ox)/r,(y-oy)/r));
}
function ridge(parent,name,keys,material){
  const rows=[];
  for(let j=0;j<=32;j++){
    const u=j/32,[x,y,w,d,offset]=sample(keys,u);
    const a=sample(keys,Math.max(0,u-.001)),b=sample(keys,Math.min(1,u+.001));
    const length=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])||1;
    const nx=-(b[1]-a[1])/length,ny=(b[0]-a[0])/length;
    const z=faceZ(x,y)+offset;
    rows.push(Array.from({length:16},(_,i)=>{
      const angle=i*TAU/16,k=Math.cos(angle)*Math.max(.01,w);
      return point(x+nx*k,y+ny*k,z+Math.sin(angle)*d);
    }));
  }
  return gridMesh(parent,name,rows,material,null,true);
}
function lid(name,knots){
  const g=group(eyes,name);
  ridge(g,'golden-lid',knots.map(([x,y,w])=>[x,y+.8,w*1.35,.95,.36]),lidMat);
  ridge(g,'dark-eyelid-crease',knots.map(([x,y,w])=>[x,y,w,1,.95]),browMat);
}
lid('eye-image-left',[[100.4,23.8,.04],[101.8,20.1,.97],[104.3,18.8,1.56],[107.4,19.1,1.5],[110.5,20.9,.83],[112.5,22.6,.04]]);
lid('eye-image-right',[[132.8,29,.04],[135.4,26.9,1.12],[138.6,27,1.65],[142,28.6,1.54],[144.9,31.1,1.02],[146.1,33.9,.05]]);
function edgeZ(x,y){
  const d=Math.hypot(x-ox,y-oy),dx=(x-ox)/d,dy=(y-oy)/d;
  const r=radius(opening,dx,dy);
  return skullDepth(ox+r*dx,oy+r*dy,r,radius(skull,dx,dy))+(dy>.1?3:1.7);
}
const teeth=group(mouth,'teeth');
function tooth(name,x,y,width,height,angle,upper){
  const g=group(teeth,name);
  const dir=upper?-1:1,shape=new THREE.Shape(),w=width*.5;
  shape.moveTo(-w*.86,-dir*.9);
  shape.quadraticCurveTo(-w*1.08,dir*height*.33,-w*.82,dir*height*.82);
  shape.quadraticCurveTo(-w*.58,dir*height*1.02,0,dir*height);
  shape.quadraticCurveTo(w*.71,dir*height*1.02,w*.85,dir*height*.78);
  shape.lineTo(w,-dir*.8);
  shape.closePath();
  const geo=new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape,{depth:.72,bevelEnabled:true,
    bevelSegments:3,steps:1,bevelSize:.29,bevelThickness:.32,curveSegments:5});
  const p=point(x,y,edgeZ(x,y)-1.15);
  geo.rotateZ(-angle);
  geo.translate(p.x,p.y,p.z);
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,ivory);
  mesh.name='rounded-enamel';
  g.add(mesh);
}

const headKeys=[
  // upper jaw x, y, depth, roll, upward pitch, yaw, jaw opening
  [119.8,36.8,32.5,14,0,0,1],

  [86.7,54.6,41,-2,-7,-22,.83],
  [82.5,105.8,51,-34,-19,-28,.67]
];
const anchor=point(119.8,36.8,32.5);
const undoRoll=14*radians,cr=Math.cos(undoRoll),sr=Math.sin(undoRoll);
const jawMeshes=[];
head.traverse(obj=>{
  if(!obj.isMesh)return;
  const geo=obj.geometry,original=geo.getAttribute('position');
  const jaw=new Float32Array(original.array);
  for(let i=0;i<original.count;i++){
    const dx=original.getX(i)-anchor.x,dy=anchor.y-original.getY(i);
    const down=-sr*dx+cr*dy;
    const displacement=.4*Math.max(0,down);
    jaw[3*i]+=sr*displacement;
    jaw[3*i+1]+=cr*displacement;
  }
  geo.morphAttributes.position=[new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(jaw,3)];
  obj.updateMorphTargets();
  obj.frustumCulled=false;
  jawMeshes.push(obj);
});
const rotUndo=new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(0,0,1),undoRoll);
const axisX=new THREE.Vector3(1,0,0),axisY=new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),axisZ=new THREE.Vector3(0,0,1);
function placeHead(i,j,u){
  const [x,y,z,roll,pitch,yaw,opening]=headKeys[i].map((v,k)=>lerp(v,headKeys[j][k],u));
  head.quaternion.setFromAxisAngle(axisZ,-roll*radians)
    .multiply(new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(axisY,yaw*radians))
    .multiply(new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(axisX,-pitch*radians))
    .multiply(rotUndo);
  head.position.copy(point(x,y,z)).sub(anchor.clone().applyQuaternion(head.quaternion));
  for(const mesh of jawMeshes)mesh.morphTargetInfluences[0]=(1-opening)/.4;
}

function render(t=0){
  const phase=((t%1220)+1220)%1220;
  let i=0;
  while(i<7&&phase>=times[i+1])i++;
  const j=(i+1)%8;
  const v=(phase-times[i])/(times[i+1]-times[i]);
  const u=v*v*(3-2*v);
  for(const mesh of animated){
    const weights=mesh.morphTargetInfluences;
    weights.fill(0);
    if(i>0)weights[i-1]=1-u;
    if(j>0)weights[j-1]=u;
  }
  placeHand(lh,leftWrists,leftRoll,i,j,u);
  placeHand(rh,rightWrists,rightRoll,i,j,u);
  placeHead(i,j,u);
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}
